claims: Binance Recovery Update #4, published 2026-11-01 04:08 UTC, raises the company-reported aggregate replenishment figure from 90% to approximately 95%.
The same announcement states that XRP and RLUSD are among ten named assets reported 100% backed.
The remaining 5% is described as less-liquid assets outside the named top ten.
Phase one of withdrawals is scheduled for 06:00–09:00 UTC on November 1 and explicitly includes the XRP network.
At the 05:26:16 UTC capture, the phase-one window had not started; no XRP withdrawal reopening or completed customer withdrawal was verified.
Reuters' 04:57 UTC report corroborates that Binance made the 95% and phase-one announcements, but does not independently verify reserve assets.
PR #1442 exact-head CI passed 349 tests and 8 subtests; its fail-closed gate passed with merging disabled. Main remains unchanged and privileged workflows remain active.

network_status_page.interpretation: SERVER_RENDERED_PAGE_DID_NOT_EXPOSE_ASSET_ROWS; NOT EVIDENCE THAT XRP IS OPEN OR SUSPENDED

evidence_classification.confirmed_primary: The official Binance announcement states the 95% aggregate figure, top-ten coverage claim and phase-one asset/network list.
evidence_classification.corroborated_secondary: Reuters reports the same announcement; this is not independent verification of Binance's reserve assets.
evidence_classification.inference: The announced phase-one XRP network reopening creates a measurable event window for subsequent exchange outflows, if service availability is confirmed.
evidence_classification.speculation_not_admitted: Any claim that Binance bought a specific quantity of XRP, that customers will sell withdrawn XRP, or that the reopening will cause XRP price appreciation/depreciation.
unknowns: Actual XRP-specific replenishment purchases and funding sources.
Actual XRP withdrawal availability and first successful withdrawal timestamp.
Customer outflow totals and destination classifications.
Full cryptographic reserve proof and liability reconciliation.
Current balance and later activity of the 233.46M-XRP attacker receiver.
November 1 escrow Destination fields and subsequent disposition.
